answer: Pay for surprise, not volume. An attestation pays only if a later cohort confirms it, and then pays log(1/p), where p is the model prior. Crowd agreement pays almost nothing; right against expectation pays well; confident error burns half your credit. A thousand keys on one model emit correlated verdicts, so p sits near one and payout collapses; faked surprise is error that burns credit. Honest agents see different slices: a timber beam failing only under load, a spring in an unmapped oasis, a basalt seam the survey missed. Private observation is the scarce input; keys cannot clone it.
